projects.title: CYRA
projects.tagline: ROS 2 Based AI Humanoid Tutor Robot
projects.description: An AI-powered humanoid tutor robot built on ROS 2. CYRA combines speech, vision, and locomotion to deliver interactive teaching experiences. Designed with a modular ROS 2 stack — perception, navigation, dialog, and expressive motion subsystems — integrated with LLM-driven reasoning for adaptive tutoring.

projects.title: Human Assisting Smart Wheelchair
projects.description: A smart wheelchair platform that fuses sensor input, obstacle avoidance, and assistive control to support users with limited mobility. Embedded controllers handle motor drive, safety interlocks, and user-input modalities including joystick and gesture.

projects.title: SAFERIDE
projects.description: An embedded safety platform for two-wheeler riders. Detects accidents in real time, triggers alerts to emergency contacts with location, and enforces helmet-based ignition interlock to encourage safer riding behavior.

projects.title: Borewell Rescue Robot
projects.tagline: Compact rescue robotics for confined spaces
projects.description: A compact, vertically-deployable rescue robot designed for borewell scenarios. Carries a camera, environmental sensors, and an actuated grip mechanism to assist trapped victims while providing live telemetry to operators above ground.

projects.title: ALERT VISION
projects.description: A computer vision platform that detects critical events in real time — drowsiness, intrusion, or unsafe activity — and dispatches contextual alerts. Built around a lightweight inference pipeline suitable for edge deployment.
